q: Natural gradient descent, introduced by Amari, uses the update rule θ ← θ − η G⁻¹(θ) ∇L(θ), where G is the Fisher information matrix. Its advantage over standard gradient descent is:
opts: It is parametrization invariant—the update direction is the steepest descent in the intrinsic geometry of the model
exp: Natural gradient descent is invariant under reparametrization of the model, unlike standard gradient descent. It follows the steepest descent direction in the Riemannian geometry defined by the Fisher metric.
